property_summary: For any valid inputs that do not revert, C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant changes the final return to false so some inputs will make the call succeed but return false, violating the property.

For all inputs where the call completes (does not revert), the reference C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for those same inputs, so there exists inputs where the return value differs (reference returns true but mutant returns false).

For every admissible input where transfer(...) completes successfully (does not revert), the reference C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant that returns false will therefore violate this rule for some inputs.
